name: Metapic – Advertiser for WooCommerce
author: erik123456

sections.description:
Metapic is a self-service, performance-based, influencer affiliate marketing solution for small businesses and start-ups wanting to increase online visibility, traffic, and product sales.

Download the Metapic influencer Affiliate Marketing plugin and start your affiliate program in minutes.

The Metapic WooCommerce Module allows you to set up and manage your Metapic affiliate program natively, within your WooCommerce store.
When you join Metapic, we provide you with the tools you need to search for and recruit your own influencer affiliates from our established partner network. Giving you access to over 180,000 partners, who are ready and waiting to promote your business.

About

The Metapic WooCommerce module will take care of all your technical requirements by ensuring that your affiliate tracking is set up quickly and correctly. This module will also automatically create your product feed to the best standard and retrieve your existing discount codes so that they’re ready for your partners within minutes of signing up. With Metapic, influencer affiliate marketing has never been easier.

All your activity will be presented in your WooCommerce module, with useful statistics and information to provide insights on traffic, conversion rates, return on ad spend (ROAS), impressions, sales information and much, much more.

Features

Metapic takes care of:

  • Sales Tracking: Complete and accurate tracking of all online journeys leading up to a sale
  • Invoicing: Streamlined finance processes resulting in simplified invoicing
  • Affiliate Payments: You focus on making partnerships, we handle the payment process
  • Client Support: Fast and effective email support to help you when you need it

    • Privacy

    Metapic will process sales information, including the Transaction ID (order number), for the purpose of recording sales information and reporting it to you and the influencer. This data will be sent and processed via Metapic’s own domains. Please see the Metapic privacy policy for more information.

    Using a Third-Party Service

    This plugin uses Metapic (https://metapic.com/), a self-service affiliate marketing platform, to track affiliate sales and manage your affiliate program.

    Data Sent to Metapic:
    – Sales information: This includes order information and the transaction ID (order number) used to track and report sales to advertisers and influencer.

    Links:
    – Metapic website: https://metapic.com/
    – Metapic privacy policy: https://metapic.com/en/privacy-policy

    Please note: By using this plugin, you agree to Metapic’s terms of service and privacy policy.
sections.installation:
1. Simply Sign up to Metapic
  2. Follow the four-step set-up guide on the Metapic platform
